briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has entered a high-velocity phase with multiple frontier labs releasing upgraded models in August. Investment continues at record pace while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agent deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4-preview with advanced reasoning chains. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus targeting enterprise multi-agent workflows. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta's Llama 4.1 both hit public benchmarks this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive CAN bus, IoT, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping to 1.2M units by Q4. Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 500MW AI data centers in Texas and Nevada.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: How will nations coordinate on compute export controls once AGI-level systems approach 10^28 FLOP training runs?
